title: I wish + past
note: Past form, present meaning: I wish I had more time. Czech Kez bych. Target error *I wish I have. Same backward shift as b1_second_conditional, which plays immediately before, so the shift is recycled rather than re-explained (F1). wish + past perfect (regret about the past) stays at B2 in b2_wish_if_only. First draft 2026-09-02, rough - thicken after smoke.

cards.title: I wish + past
cards.title_cz: I wish + minulý tvar — kéž bych
points: The verb goes back one step, but the meaning is about **now**.

rows: I want it to be different **now**
I want to be able to, now

cards.title: The same step back as the if sentence
cards.title_cz: Stejný krok zpět jako u věty s if
points: If the real sentence is negative, the wish is positive, and the other way round.

rows: **were** for every person, like the if phrase
heard in speech, but **were** is the set form

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: After **wish**, the verb steps back — never stays in the present.

rows: ~~I wish I would have a car.~~

items.en: I wish I had more time.
accepts: I wish I had more time.
items.wrong: I wish I have more time.
items.explanation: **wish** + the past form **had**, even though it is about now.
items.explanation_cz: **wish** + minulý tvar **had**, i když jde o teď.

items.en: I wish I could speak Spanish.
accepts: I wish I could speak Spanish.
items.wrong: I wish I can speak Spanish.

items.en: She wishes she lived closer to work.
items.cz: Přeje si, aby bydlela blíž k práci.
items.gap: She wishes she ____ closer to work. (live)
accepts: She wishes she lived closer to work.
items.explanation: Past form **lived** for a present wish.
items.explanation_cz: Minulý tvar **lived** pro přání o přítomnosti.

items.explanation: **were** is the set form after wish, for every person.
items.explanation_cz: **were** je ustálený tvar po wish, pro každou osobu.

items.en: I wish it wasn't so cold.
items.gap: I wish it ____ so cold. (not / be)
accepts: I wish it wasn't so cold.
I wish it weren't so cold.
I wish it was not so cold.
I wish it were not so cold.
items.explanation: The real sentence is *it is cold*, so the wish is negative: **wasn't**.
items.explanation_cz: Skutečnost je *it is cold*, takže přání je záporné: **wasn't**.

items.en: I wish I knew his name.
accepts: I wish I knew his name.
items.wrong: I wish I know his name.
items.explanation: **knew** — the point is that I do not know it now.
items.explanation_cz: **knew** — jde o to, že ho teď neznám.

items.en: They wish they had a bigger flat.
items.gap: They wish they ____ a bigger flat. (have)
accepts: They wish they had a bigger flat.
items.explanation: Past form **had** after wish, for a flat they do not have now.
items.explanation_cz: Minulý tvar **had** po wish, o bytě, který teď nemají.

items.en: I wish my neighbours weren't so loud.
items.cz: Kéž by sousedi nebyli tak hluční.
items.gap: I wish my neighbours ____ so loud. (not / be)
accepts: I wish my neighbours weren't so loud.
I wish my neighbours were not so loud.
items.explanation_cz: Podmět v množném čísle, takže **weren't** po wish.

items.en: He wishes he could come with us.
items.cz: Přeje si, aby mohl jet s námi.
items.gap: He wishes he ____ come with us. (can)
accepts: He wishes he could come with us.

items.en: I wish I had a car.
accepts: I wish I had a car.
items.wrong: I wish I would have a car.
items.explanation: **had**, not would have. would after wish is for asking someone to change.
items.explanation_cz: **had**, ne would have. would po wish se používá, když chceš, aby někdo něco změnil.
